audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Lillia / Skill x5 / Lillia on both layers, which is close to the exact inverse of the packet (Skill / Lillia x5 / Urgot) and contradicts every one of its own why-strings — whys[0] says level 1 is even, whys[1] through whys[5] describe Lillia kiting and out-poking, and whys[6] says Urgot takes over at two items.
audit.why: Lillia's stacking move speed off Blooming Blows keeps her outside Purge's 490 range through the mid levels; the lane only inverts once Urgot's items land and his R can execute her thin base resistances. The page currently shows a coinflip mid-game and a Lillia late game, both backwards.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full+content pairs to the packet chart, ratings realigned, and six phase whys rewritten to state each row's real reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item rows carried generic Urgot-spike boilerplate ('Fear Beyond Death online', 'Black Cleaver stacks instantly') on rows the data gives to Lillia, and no cooldown number appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 falling to 110s — the single longest cooldown in the matchup and therefore the largest free window once she spends it. Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and Swirlseed a flat 12s.
audit.corrected: phases[4], phases[5] and phases[6] whys rewritten around the 150s Lullaby and the item inversion; breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d given the 6s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were missing entirely: the outer edge of Blooming Blows deals TRUE damage, and Swirlseed's slow denies the movement on Corrosive Charge. The interaction fields said only 'Her kite + move speed stacks'.
audit.why: The true-damage edge is why 'just build armour' loses this lane — resistances do not reduce it, so the answer is to step out of the ring rather than tank it. And because her E slows at 700 range, she can deny your approach before you are ever in Purge's 490.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d now state the true-damage edge and the E slow denying your approach; dontsFull[1].d states the 150s Lullaby window.
